text:
Zach Nunn discusses housing reform, crime prevention bills in latest social media posts
B. R. Jones
U.S. Representative Zach Nunn, who serves Iowa’s Third Congressional District, addressed a range of legislative priorities in a series of posts on July 21, 2026.
In his first post, Nunn highlighted recent legislative achievements and ongoing efforts for government accountability: "Join us on @the535news where we’re talking about the largest housing package in a generation — now law — and something 87% of Americans agree with: passing our bill to ban Members of Congress from trading individual stocks. https://t.co/0rqNhWqzkx" (July 21, 2026).
Later that day, Nunn drew attention to criminal activity affecting Iowa farmers and advocated for new law enforcement tools: "Southeast Asia scam artists weren’t satisfied with stealing an Iowa farmer’s life savings. They sent armed criminals to his farm to take even more. That’s why our GUARD Act is a must-pass: it equips local law enforcement with new tools to investigate and dismantle the criminal https://t.co/wmpkVxYP7r" (July 21, 2026).
In another post, Nunn discussed adoption and kinship care legislation: "Kelly and I adopted two of our daughters, and across the country, there are 2.5 million kids being raised by relatives or family friends — proof that not every family looks the same. Our bill with @RepBonamici ensures that when a family steps up to take care of a child, they https://t.co/cTt3tXCQLU" (July 21, 2026).
Zach Nunn's office is based in Des Moines and represents residents across 21 counties in central and southern Iowa (official website). He has prioritized bipartisan policies focused on economic growth, agricultural support, government accountability, national security enhancements, and assistance for families and children. As a member of both the House Financial Services Committee and the House Agriculture Committee, Nunn has emphasized pragmatic solutions tailored to his district’s needs.
His office also provides constituent services related to federal agencies (official website), reinforcing his commitment to serving Iowans through legislative action as well as direct support.
